Travel with Pets: What to Know at the Desk

If you are bringing a companion animal on an Aurelia Skyways trip, please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you head to the gate. Our team is there to help keep the process calm, safe, and clear for both you and your animal.

The senior coordinator reviews daily service choices and helps make sure each case is handled with care. The ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and the desk staff note any service changes in the ledger so the next step stays easy to follow. If your plans shift, or if your animal seems unsettled, let us know right away so we can help sort things out in a steady way.

We know travel can feel busy, especially when a pet is part of the journey. That is why we try to give plain answers, kind guidance, and close attention to the details that matter most. Whether you are traveling with Basil or another companion animal, we want you to feel supported from check-in to departure.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly help with your pet travel needs.
